conviction_note: The two questions split hard here: I think the number beats (management has beaten its own quarterly revenue guide by +14.4% and +13.6% in the two immediately preceding quarters and the Q4 guide was set on 2026-06-05 with two of three months already elapsed), but I rebuilt this name's real earnings reaction record from confirmed release dates and it is 4 of 4 down -- 2025-09-17 -2.07%, 2025-12-02 -3.78%, 2026-03-12 -16.26%, 2026-06-05 -24.89% -- and both of the quarters where revenue beat the company's own guide were sold 16% and 25%, so the reported-quarter line has no history of paying here and I size it at +0.5 rather than at the beat. I emit -4.0, slightly beyond the -3.7 sum, because the name's own rebuilt distribution has a median absolute reaction near 10% and understatement is the documented systematic error on thin names; I do NOT emit a distribution-sized -10 because the direction is genuinely two-sided (equity is now 1.08x net cash with EV of only US$8.3m, so there is far less enterprise value left to remove than there was before the last two down prints, and 30 days-to-cover makes a squeeze a real mechanism on any good news).
bar: Company's own guide: Q4 FY2026 revenue of RMB130.0-140.0 million (midpoint 135) and FY2026 revenue of RMB600.0-610.0 million, both set in the Q3 FY2026 release of 2026-06-05, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1932770/000121390026065474/ea029361801ex99-1.htm . The FY range is purely additive (Q1 127.1 + Q2 177.3 + Q3 164.7 = 469.1, plus the Q4 guide = 599.1-609.1), so it carries no cushion of its own. There is no sell-side consensus to cross-check: coverage is effectively one broker (Citi, cut to Neutral / $2.50 from $14 on 2026-05-26) and no option market exists.
positioning_check: Short interest 548,832 shares, 2.68% of shares outstanding, short ratio 29.99 days to cover, float 18.74m of 54.38m shares -- https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/here/statistics/ read 2026-09-21. As a percentage of shares out that is not crowded, but 30 days to cover on a ~20,677-share ADV means a covering short is mechanically a squeeze, which is a reason to shrink a negative here. There is NO options market (baseline options.status = no_options_market), so there is no skew and no implied move -- the market makes no directional statement about this print at all, and I have no anchor for what is priced beyond the tape: run_up_20d -1.62%, run_up_5d -3.19%, i.e. flat and unpositioned into the event. Largest disclosed holder KPartners Limited / Rui Zhang at 23,170,342 Class A shares (14.2%), routine quarterly 13G/A, event date 2026-06-30, filed 2026-08-11, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/0001932770/000172704226000003/primary_doc.xml -- no 13D and no activist.

findings.finding: Management has beaten the midpoint of its own quarterly revenue guide by +14.4% and +13.6% in the two immediately preceding quarters (Q2 guided RMB150-160m on 2025-12-02, printed RMB177.3m; Q3 guided RMB140-150m on 2026-03-12, printed RMB164.7m), and the Q4 guide of RMB130-140m was set on 2026-06-05 with two of the quarter's three months already elapsed -- so Q4 revenue should land near RMB148-155m and FY2026 revenue above the top of the revised RMB600-610m range.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This exact line has been sold twice in a row: the Q2 print beat its guided range by 14.4% and the stock fell 16.26% (2026-03-12); the Q3 print beat its guided range by 13.6%, the CFO's own quote said results 'exceeded expectations on both revenue and gross margin', and the stock fell 24.89% (2026-06-05, close 2.37 -> 1.78 on 431,500 shares). A revenue beat against this company's own guide has a 0-for-2 record of paying, which is why this is sized at +0.5 and not at the beat.
findings.why_not_priced: Every piece of English wire copy on this name leads with the 22% FY guidance cut, not with the fact that the company has beaten each of the two quarterly ranges it set since. If the pattern were priced, the stock would not be at 1.08x net cash with EV of US$8.3m and a single broker at a $2.50 target; you would also see some run-up into the print, and the tape is -1.62% over 20 sessions on 20,677 shares a day. The three data points have to be assembled from three separate releases; no aggregator carries guide-vs-actual for this name.
findings.independence: Q1 FY26 release giving the Q2 guide: https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/12/02/3197667/0/en/Here-Announces-Unaudited-Financial-Results-for-the-First-Quarter-of-Fiscal-Year-2026.html ; Q2 FY26 release giving the Q3 guide and the Q2 actual: https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1932770/000121390026026610/ea028104301ex99-1.htm . NOTE: this finding and finding 2 rest on the same two quarters' releases read two different ways (one as a guidance-setting pattern, one as a reaction record); I have shrunk this one to +0.5 to avoid counting the same two quarters twice.

findings.finding: The baseline's reaction history is wrong and the real one is far worse and far larger: rebuilt from confirmed release dates, this stock has fallen on 4 of 4 earnings prints -- 2025-09-17 (FY25 annual, bmo) -2.07%, 2025-12-02 -3.78%, 2026-03-12 -16.26%, 2026-06-05 -24.89% -- and the accessible wire copy misreports the 2026-06-05 move as -5.68% when the daily bars show 2.37 -> 1.78.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: This finding IS the reaction history. The baseline carries median_abs_move_pct 3.78 and expected_move_pct 3.78 off three 6-K text matches on an inferred 61-day cadence it calls implausible; the sweep flagged baseline_history_trustworthy: false. Rebuilt from the four confirmed releases (2025-09-17, 2025-12-02, 2026-03-12, 2026-06-05) the median absolute reaction is ~10% and the two most recent prints, both under the pop-toy-only business, are -16.26% and -24.89%. The mean is -11.75%. No print has been up.
findings.why_not_priced: There is no option chain on this name, so there is no implied move for anyone to have marked to this distribution, and the one aggregator statement I could find prices the June reaction at -5.68% -- a fifth of what actually happened. The only anchor anyone else has is the same 3.78% median the sealed baseline built from non-earnings 6-Ks. If the market were carrying a 10-25% event distribution you would see it in the tape into the print; instead the stock is dead flat on 20k shares a day. A shareholder base that has sold this name on every print including two revenue beats is a mechanism, not a mood.
findings.independence: Same measurement on three other windows from the same price source, each cross-checked against a confirmed release date: 2026-03-12 gives -16.37% against the baseline's independently computed -16.26% (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/HERE?period1=1773014400&period2=1773532800&interval=1d) and 2025-12-02 gives -3.78%, matching the baseline exactly (https://query1.finance.yahoo.com/v8/finance/chart/HERE?period1=1764201600&period2=1765065600&interval=1d), which validates the date mapping used for the June figure. The 2025-09-17 annual print is confirmed as a real event by https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2025/09/11/3148378/0/en/QuantaSing-to-Report-Fourth-Fiscal-Quarter-and-Full-Fiscal-Year-2025-Financial-Results-on-September-17-2025.html . Shares the two Q2/Q3 releases with finding 1; the price series is a different source.

findings.finding: The equity is a cash box with a live buyback the size of a fifth of itself: net cash US$91.76m against a US$100.07m market cap (EV US$8.31m), a new US$20.0m repurchase authorisation running 2026-07-01 to 2027-06-30 that was announced with the guidance cut, US$12.8m already spent of the prior US$20m programme, and a board with form for autumn capital return (US$11m special dividend declared 2024-10-01). The FY release is where usage of the 2026 programme gets disclosed.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: The 2026 buyback was announced on 2026-06-05 inside the guidance-cut release and the stock still fell 24.89%, so an authorisation alone has demonstrably bought nothing here. What has never been tested at this price is a disclosed repurchase figure or a distribution: the only cash distribution in the company's history (2024-10-01, US$0.067/ordinary, US$0.201/ADS, ~US$11m) came two weeks after an annual results release, not inside one.
findings.why_not_priced: At 1.08x net cash with EV of US$8.3m the market is explicitly pricing the cash to be burned rather than returned; that is the price statement, and any disclosure that contradicts it is unpriced by construction. A US$20m authorisation is 20% of the market cap and ~59% of the float's market value on a name trading US$38k a day -- if it were credited, the stock could not sit at 1.08x cash with no bid. Nobody models this: one broker, no options, no run-up.
findings.independence: The 2026 authorisation and the US$12.8m spent under the 2025 programme as of 2026-06-01 are in the company's own Q3 release, https://www.sec.gov/Archives/edgar/data/1932770/000121390026065474/ea029361801ex99-1.htm ; the special-dividend precedent is a separate release, https://www.globenewswire.com/news-release/2024/10/01/2955953/0/en/QuantaSing-Announces-Declaration-of-a-Special-Dividend.html . I deliberately dropped the one supporting item that was inference rather than document -- July 2026 volume averaged ~56,000 shares/day against ~18,600 in August (https://stockanalysis.com/stocks/here/history/) which is consistent with company buying but is not evidence of it, and a volume series is not a company number.

findings.finding: Two forward items surfaced in Chinese-language media in the ten days before the print and appear in no English coverage: the fifth-generation WAKUKU line '怪上头' went on sale offline on 2026-09-21 with the online drop at 20:00 Beijing on 2026-09-22 (the day of the call), and at CIFTIS on 2026-09-11 the company said overseas is ~20% of group annual revenue, products sell into 27 countries, and its target is overseas sales of 3-5x the prior year.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Untested on this line at this name: the initial FY guide given at the last annual print (FY26 RMB750-800m, 2025-09-17) produced only -2.07%, the smallest reaction of the four, and it was then cut 22% eight months later -- so this shareholder base did not pay for an optimistic initial guide and was later proved right not to. Tomorrow's release should carry an initial FY2027 guide on the same template, and that, not the Q4 number, is the line that will set the move.
findings.why_not_priced: Both are Chinese-language only; there is no English wire item, no broker note and no aggregator entry for either, and a $38k/day ADR's marginal holder is not reading Tencent News. If they were priced you would see some bid into a print that is instead flat on the 5- and 20-day tape. A company that sends staff to a trade fair on 2026-09-11 to talk about a 3-5x overseas target and drops a fifth-generation flagship line the morning of its own call is not, on the face of it, about to guide FY2027 down -- though this is a target and a launch, not a number, which is why it is sized at +0.5.
findings.independence: Different article, same day, different subject: the first IP-immersive WAKUKU themed river-cruise venue in Hong Kong, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260921A08IHS00 . The overseas mix statement is a third article, https://news.qq.com/rain/a/20260912A0AU4W00 (2026-09-12). Cutting the other way, and I have not filed it as a finding because it is already the consensus story Citi cut to $2.50 on: the category decelerated hard in H1 2026 (Pop Mart overseas revenue -11.1% y/y, https://kr-asia.com/pop-marts-next-act-gets-harder-as-labubu-growth-cools) while HERE's flagship WAKUKU fell from RMB129.4m to RMB102.4m q/q.

outside_window.finding: The audited FY2026 Form 20-F -- auditor's opinion, the goodwill test on the Letsvan acquisition (61% bought for RMB235.0m cash completed 2025-03-31, the remaining stake paid in 18,219,330 Class A ordinary shares to founder Huiyu Zhan in three vesting installments) and any going-concern language -- is not in tomorrow's release, which is explicitly unaudited. searched_and_found_nothing: No SEC filing of any kind between the 2026-06-05 6-K and the print except a routine quarterly Schedule 13G/A from KPartners/K2 Partners (14.2%, filed 2026-08-11) and a Form 3/A (2026-06-17) -- no 13D, no activist, no quiet 8-K equivalent: https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001932770&type=&dateb=&owner=include&count=40&datea=20260601
No Nasdaq listing-deficiency notice, minimum-bid or market-value-of-publicly-held-shares correspondence found; the stock is at $1.82 and float value ~$34m, so neither test is near.
No going-private proposal, tender offer or take-private chatter found despite EV of US$8.3m and majority insider control.

No sourceable goodwill or intangible balance for the Letsvan acquisition, so no impairment finding was filed -- shareholders' equity of RMB857.9m against RMB728.3m of cash and short-term investments at 2025-12-31 bounds non-cash net assets at roughly RMB130m, but that is an inference and I would not size on it.

No Tmall/Douyin/JD monthly GMV series for WAKUKU covering Jul-Sep 2026; the only quantified e-commerce datum found was a 52-week blind-box ranking band of 50k-100k units per series, undated at the series level.
No self-operated store count for Jul-Sep 2026; the last sourceable target was 6 stores by end of calendar Q1 2026.
seekingalpha.com/article/4943896 returned HTTP 403 and www.nasdaq.com news-headlines returned HTTP 503, so the two most likely sources of recent English commentary could not be read.
No options market at all, so no skew, no implied move, and no market statement of what is priced into this print.
baseline_tension: Nothing in the baseline can be cut against, because the baseline has no directional content: there is no option chain, no skew, and the 20-day run-up is -1.62% -- flat -- so the market has taken no position into this print; the one part of the baseline that does speak, its 3.78% expected move, I contradict directly, having rebuilt the reaction record from four confirmed releases to a median absolute reaction near 10% with two of the last two prints at -16.26% and -24.89%.
lessons_applied: Lesson 3 / 'two readings of one document are one finding': findings 1 and 2 both rest on the Q2 and Q3 FY26 releases (one as a guide-setting pattern, one as a reaction record). I did not collapse them because the reaction evidence is a separate price series, but I cut finding 1 from +1.0 to +0.5 and declared the shared documents in both independence fields.
Lesson 7 / positioning: 29.99 days to cover on a 20,677-share ADV makes a squeeze a real mechanism against my net negative, so I shrank finding 2 from -6.0 to -5.5.

Lesson 5 / 'documents beat inference': I removed the July-2026 volume spike (~56,000 shares/day against ~18,600 in August) as evidence that the company has been executing the new buyback. It is a price-series inference with no company document behind it. Finding 3 fell from +1.0 to +0.8 and now rests only on the sourced balance sheet, the sourced authorisation and the sourced 2024 dividend precedent.

Lesson 8 / 'understatement is the systematic error on thin names, size on the name's own distribution': I widened finding 2's band to -16.0/+1.0 to match the rebuilt distribution, and moved expected_move_pct from -3.5 to -4.0, deliberately beyond the -3.7 finding sum, with the reason stated in conviction_note.

Lesson 1 left standing and already in the draft: print_vs_bar_pct +11.0 against expected_move_pct -4.0, with the reaction function vetoing the beat because this name has sold two consecutive beats of its own guide.

Lesson 6 left standing: the bar is a company guide from a primary document, not a consensus, so no small-size cap was applied; all four findings resolve 2026-09-22 and the two dated later (the 20-F and the 2026-10-01 Hong Kong venue) were moved to outside_window in the draft already.
